newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle up $0.50-$1, active - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle up $0.50-$1, active - USDA.

text.p: Live Sales Compared to Tuesday's close - Slaughter steers and heifers were $0.50-$1.00 per cwt higher, USDA said. Trade was active and demand moderate to good. Seller interest moderate to good. Offerings current.
